experiment: M5c frozen Agent execution protocol validation

execution_protocol.limiter_note: Token and turn limits are checked at completed-message boundaries. Tool termination is requested after the twentieth tool completes. Bash timeout is injected by the controller when the model omits timeout.

groups.B0: task, repository, and correctness/performance objective only
groups.B1: B0 input plus mechanically rendered M4 profiler tables, with evaluator and measurement-wrapper frames removed for information-boundary safety

prompt_policy: diagnose, implement one concrete performance optimization, and run targeted tests
do not spend the entire budget only analyzing
do not enlarge formal workload inputs for expensive exploration
do not read evaluator-only or gold information

evaluation_policy.no_patch: classify as NO_PATCH and do not run the 30-sample benchmark
